title: Nine Pounds and One Scale
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：balance　|　正文 309 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 balance 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 my father kept ① a balance of nine pounds and called it safety, and my mother called it fear. The ② balance, meaning the money and not the feeling, was written in the same book for eleven years; a balance, he said, is the only number that tells you what you can afford to lose. She said he never once lost it.

Every ③ balance in that book was checked on a Sunday and argued about on the Monday. Their ④ balance in March was nine pounds and one unpaid bill; a balance, my mother said, is the only figure that is honest on paper and dishonest in a shop. He said the shop is where the dishonesty happens.

My grandmother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ balance was the whole of walking, meaning the body and not the money. The ⑥ balance, meaning the steadiness and not either of those, is nine parts practice and one part refusing to look down; a balance, she said, is either what is left in a book or what keeps you upright. She said the second matters more after seventy.

By 1972 the ⑦ balance had become a scale in the kitchen, and the scale had become an argument about the sugar. The ⑧ balance of the whole thing, my father wrote in June, was nine years of work and one letter; a balance, he said, is either the money left over or the judgement left over, and the word serves both. She said the letter was the worse half.

The ⑨ balance I remember is the nine pounds, which he never spent and never explained. A ⑩ balance, my mother said in 1977, is the only thing that can be lost by spending and by keeping; every balance, she said, is a decision that has agreed to look like arithmetic. She said the arithmetic is the alibi.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 余额（指那笔钱，与感受相对）
C. n. 余额（指三月那一笔）
D. 固定搭配：keep a balance of 保持……的余额
E. n. 平衡（身体的、走路的）
F. n. 平衡（抽象：保持稳定这件事）
H. n. 权衡；余下的判断（抽象总称）

items.q: The balance, meaning the money and not the feeling
balance was the whole of walking
the balance had become a scale in the kitchen
The balance of the whole thing
A balance, my mother said in 1977

answers.why: keep a balance of 意为“保持……的余额”，1968 年父亲保持着九镑的余额，管它叫安全，母亲管它叫害怕。
balance 意为“余额”，指那笔钱，与感受相对，它在同一本簿子里记了十一年。
balance 意为“余额、结余”，那本簿子里每一笔余额都是星期天核对、星期一争论的。
balance 指三月那一笔余额，那年三月的余额是九镑和一张未付的账单。
balance 意为“平衡（身体的）”，祖母说平衡就是走路这件事的全部，指的是身体而不是钱。
balance 意为“平衡（保持稳定这件事）”，是九分练习加一分不肯往下看。
balance 意为“天平、秤”，到 1972 年这个 balance 成了厨房里的一台秤，那台秤又成了一场关于糖的争论。
balance 意为“权衡、余下的判断”，父亲六月写道，整件事权衡下来是九年的工作和一封信。
balance 意为“余额”，我记得的是那九镑，他既没花掉，也从没解释过。
balance 为抽象总称，母亲说余额／平衡是唯一会因为你花掉而失去、也会因为你留着而失去的东西。
